Tells whether a mouse button is held down at this moment.

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
While Not KeyHit(1)
	Cls
	If MouseDown(1) Then Color 255, 80, 80 Else Color 80, 80, 80
	Rect 20, 60, 80, 80, 1
	If MouseDown(3) Then Color 255, 80, 80 Else Color 80, 80, 80
	Rect 120, 60, 80, 80, 1
	If MouseDown(2) Then Color 255, 80, 80 Else Color 80, 80, 80
	Rect 220, 60, 80, 80, 1
	Color 255, 255, 255
	Text 160, 200, "Hold a mouse button", 1, 1
	Flip
Wend
```
@param button  1 for the left, 2 for the right, 3 for the middle button, 4 for the back (X1) and 5 for the forward (X2) button.
@param device  Only look at this mouse, counted from 0 as in MouseDeviceCount. -1 (the default) means all mice together.
@returns 1 while the button is held down, otherwise 0.
@gap Buttons 4 and 5 (the back and forward buttons) are a BlitzLLVM extension. A button number outside 1 to 5 always gives 0.
@gap The Device argument is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such argument and only knows one mouse.
